# 2 Baruch Chapter 81 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** "Hear therefore, O Israel, and be instructed by me, O Jacob; and remove not from your hearts the way of life."

**2** "I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you this day, that you have chosen death and life."

**3** "And if you choose the way of life, you will live; and if you choose the way of death, you will die."

**4** "For the mercy of the Mighty One endures forever, and his power from generation to generation; and his kingdom endures forever and ever."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
